card.name: Spot where a year or date comes next
card.fires_on: Words in historical or biographical sentences just before a date phrase, such as 'in July 1994' or 'the next year'. The marked word is often a verb, place or comma that completes the clause.

modes.label: Clause end before a date
modes.description: A noun, verb or place name that finishes the event, right before a month or year.
modes.example: Dark smudges marred Jupiter's atmosphere when a series of fragments of Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 hit<< Jupiter>> in July 1994.

modes.label: Comma or 'and' before a dated phrase
modes.description: A comma or 'and' leading into a new time-marked clause.
modes.example: In 1982 he received the Brady Award for Excellence in Teaching<< and>> in 1994 the Chancellor

modes.label: Organization name before a year
modes.description: The end of a name or title, followed by the year of an event.
modes.example: She was hired in a staff position at LL<<NL>> in 1994 and worked
